args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while tests/spec require
banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Update the rounding mode so
halves round to the nearest even cent.

args.body:
## Summary

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212 but actually quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This mismatch caused `test_half_even` to fail (e.g., `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so halves round to the nearest even cent, matching the spec (FIN-212) and the existing docstring.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.
